title: qcr review --json, version 2
description: One JSON object per line from `qcr review` (also `--to json`), `qcr review start`, `status` and `stop`. schema_version leads every payload; ok says whether the call succeeded. Fields beyond those named may appear without a version change; a caller ignores what it does not know and refuses a schema_version it does not know. A failure is {ok:false, errors:[…]}; a review stopped at its cap is {ok:false, partial:true, coverage, …} with the findings written before the stop. Version 2 differs from version 1 in the preview: a review on a model with no measured price has no estimate, so estimate_usd may be null, and the preview names the model it runs on (model, alternatives, tiers) and what its price is known from (price_basis).

errors.description: Why the call failed; present when ok is false and no result exists.

partial.description: True when the review stopped at its cap before finishing.

stopped.description: True when the caller stopped the review (the review API's abort signal) before it finished: {ok:false, stopped:true, errors:[…]}. Nothing is recorded or posted; what the round wrote stays in its out dir.

coverage.description: Which planned lenses had started when a capped review stopped.

findings.description: This round's findings by severity (P0, P1, P2, … nit, other), worst first.

doubted.description: This round's candidates the validator doubted (refuted, unverifiable, …): they may not be valid, are never posted, and are not in findings or its count.

still_open.description: Findings from earlier rounds that are still open.

unchanged.description: True when nothing new was reviewed because the branch had not changed.

out_dir.description: The run's output directory, with the findings record and stage files.

report.description: Path of the markdown report, when the file destination was asked for.

customised.description: True when a profile (the user's, or the repo's .qcr/ on the base commit) replaced a shipped agent or prompt with different bytes for this review; overrides lists them.

overrides.description: The shipped files a profile replaced; empty unless customised.

post_ready.description: A finished PR review that was not posted: the file it is kept in, which a host that asks the person later posts through the gate exactly as `--to pr` would have.

run_id.description: A detached run's id (start, status, stop).

started_at.description: When a detached run was started, ms since the epoch.

ended_at.description: When a detached run ended (its exit or its stop), ms since the epoch; absent while it runs.

progress.description: While a detached run is running: the lenses started so far.

live.description: The running round's live log, projected: what the parent and each lens are doing now.

duration_ms.description: The lens's time so far; a running lens's counts from its start between updates.

tool_count.description: Tool calls the lens has started; a finished lens keeps its final count.

current_tool.description: The running (or last) tool, as `<tool>: <args>` or the bare name.

current_target.description: While the lens runs: the path its current tool works on, when it names one.

line.description: The lens as one line a person reads: `security · read src/x.ts · 7 tools · 0:41`.

result.description: A finished detached run's last JSON line: the review's own result (null if it printed none).

timed_out.description: status --wait gave up after --timeout; the run is still going.

path.description: The shipped file, relative to the app root (agents/pass-security.md).

layer.description: The profile whose file won (.qcr for the repo profile).

seed.description: True when the shipped file is a frozen seed.

kind.description: What is reviewed: a pull request, the current branch against its base, the uncommitted working tree, or a unified diff handed in (`--diff`). Only a pr target can be posted.

uncommitted.description: A branch target reviewed together with the working tree's uncommitted edits, as one review. Absent otherwise.

postable.description: True when a PR is behind the target, so --to pr applies.

head_sha.description: The reviewed head; for a diff target a hash of the diff's text.

since.description: Delta rounds: the head the earlier review was of.

fallback_reason.description: Why a follow-up round is a full review, not a delta.

model.description: The model the review runs on and why; null when no model route resolves (a start is refused) or the caller's host named none.

alternatives.description: The other providers pi has a usable credential for, each with the model it would run, best first. `qcr model use <provider>` picks one.

tiers.description: Each tier's model spec as it will run (`provider/id:level`); a tier is a bare `:level` when no route resolves.

refusal.description: Present when a start would be refused: no model route resolves (model is null), or a pinned tier or lens cannot run here. code says which: no-credential (no model login), login-too-short, no-model, pin-no-credential, pin-unknown. text is the sentence for the person, with what to do about it. Only no-credential is cured by signing in.

price_basis.description: What the price is known from. measured: every model the run uses is the one the estimate was fitted on. repo: the repo's own rates (.git/qcr-review.json). unmeasured: pi prices the model and no estimate exists, so the run is held by a spend limit (cap_usd). unpriced: pi has no price for the model, so there is no dollar stop. unknown: no model route resolves.

estimate_usd.description: The estimated cost; null when price_basis is unmeasured, unpriced or unknown.

cap_usd.description: The hard stop: twice the estimate where there is one, the spend limit on an unmeasured model. Null where there is none: the Action route without --limit, an unpriced model, no model route.

limit_usd.description: With an estimate: the estimate up to which the review runs without asking. On an unmeasured model: the spend limit (equal to cap_usd). Null where neither applies.

auto.description: True when the review runs without a confirmation. On an unmeasured model that takes the person's word once: --limit on the run, a yes at a terminal, or a start with the key.

key.description: Quote it with --key to confirm a review over the limit, or one with no estimate. It moves with the branch, the plan, the stop and the models the run is on.

title.description: The candidate's own title, else its evidence's first line; never the validator's reason.

word.description: The validator's closed-vocabulary word (refuted, unverifiable, bad-anchor, partial-chain).

reason.description: The validator's reason, in its own words.

post.description: What --to pr did. In a dry-run install the review is recorded, not sent.

origin.description: Where pi found it: its own login store, a key handed to it for the run, the person's models.json, an environment key, or a cloud identity the environment carries.

subscription.description: A login backed by a provider subscription: list prices are not what the person is billed.

credential.description: Whose credential a provider runs on. Never a value.

source.description: What decided the route: --model, the config's pin, a stated or remembered choice, the only credential, the provider pi itself is on, or the credential order.

pi_default.description: pi's own default on the provider when the pick differs from it.

custom.description: The id is not in pi's catalog and is sent as written.

moved_from.description: The provider a pin named, when the run moved off it for want of a credential.

priced.description: pi has a non-zero list price for the model.

ask.description: Two or more providers tie and nothing decided: show the person the alternatives, and keep their answer with `qcr model use <provider>`.
